verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official MCP server that lets agents create/toggle feature flags from plain text prompts ('ship a feature flag from a prompt'), plus a public OpenAPI spec confirming API-based flag management is exposed programmatically. Docs also describe flag targeting by person property/cohort/group, which combined with MCP/API access covers create, target, and toggle. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or example of the MCP server exposing 'target by cohort/property' as a distinct callable action, and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
